persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Use a clear frame from my video to make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail. Keep me recognisable and add “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. Pick the frame yourself; make it warm and upbeat.

bank.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.
bank.Visual style: Warm and upbeat, with big text beside my face; colours and font are your call.

messages.text: Could you use a clear frame from the attached clip to make a thumbnail for me, and pick the frame yourself rather than having me choose one? I’m hoping this will make the video feel a little more inviting when people first come across it. What I need is a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail, with me kept recognisable and the exact words “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. I always get a bit nervous about how I’ll look in a still pulled from a video. Please make the thumbnail warm and upbeat.
